notes: DCA prospective need 473 (document says 249, accepted per Resolution #049-2025, Jan 23 2025); DCA present need 75 (HEFSP uses 76). Note: HEFSP text at Section 3.1 and Table 18 states the 4th Round obligation as prospective need 249 and rehabilitation 76 — DCA JSON has 473/75. The HEFSP explicitly says 'The Borough has a 4th Round prospective need of 249 units and a rehabilitation obligation of 75 units' (correction in plan: actually listed as 76 in Table 18). DCA figures differ significantly (prospective 473 vs. 249); HEFSP accepted 249 per resolution. VLA conducted; RDP=6 for 4th Round (based on 3 bold lots in Table 20: Block 1703/28, Block 2101/4, Block 2101/30). Borough plans to address RDP=6 via 42-unit 100% affordable development at Block 1605 Lots 1 & 2 (20-22 East Allendale Road). Unmet need = 243 units addressed through 32 units from Choctau Trail site (Block 1601 Lots 10, 10.01, 11 — remaining from 3rd Round allocation). Rehabilitation obligation reduced from 76/75 to 6 units after Borough construction official site inspection. Present need met via Bergen County Rehabilitation Program. HEFSP adopted by Planning Board Resolution 25-14 and endorsed by Council, June 25 2025. Docket BER-L-000517-25, filed 06/27/2025.

sources.title: Saddle River Housing Element and Fair Share Plan (Adopted June 25, 2025)
sources.excerpt: The Borough has a 4th Round prospective need of 249 units and a rehabilitation obligation of 75 units. A site inspection by the Borough construction official determined the Borough's rehabilitation obligation is actually 6 units. A vacant land analysis (VLA) was undertaken and a determination was made that the Borough's prospective need number is reduced to a realistic development potential (RDP) of 6 units.

sites.site_name: 20-22 East Allendale Road (AH-6 Zone / Block 1605 Lots 1 & 2) — 4th Round RDP Site
sites.current_zoning: AH-3 Zone (Lot 1 only, previously approved 23 units)
sites.proposed_zoning: AH-6 Zone (expanded to include Lot 2, 42 units total)
sites.adoption_status: Planning Board approved site plan for Lot 1 (23 units, Sept 2020); Lot 2 being added via rezoning
sites.quote: The Borough will satisfy its 6 unit RDP obligation with a 42 unit 100 percent proposed affordable housing development at 20-22 East Allendale Road. The property is identified as Block 1605 Lots 1 and 2. The Michaels Organization, who is developing the Choctau Road site noted above, will be the developer of this property ... Block 1605 Lot 1 ... 1.06 acre property ... Block 1605 Lot 2 ... the adjoining Lot 2 ... a total of 42 units on 1.54 acres. This represents a density of 27.2 units per acre.
sites.notes: 4th Round RDP site (6 units credit). Lot 1 (1.06 ac, 20 E. Allendale Rd) previously approved for 23 units under AH-3 zoning; now combined with Lot 2 for 42 total affordable units. Developer is The Michaels Organization (same as Choctau Trail). Maximum density 27.5 du/ac per zoning table.

sites.site_name: Choctau Trail (Block 1601 Lots 10, 10.01 & 11) — 4th Round Unmet Need Component
sites.adoption_status: site plan approved September 2021; under construction
sites.source_page: Section 4.1 / Prior Round Obligations (p. 33); Section 4.2 / Unmet Need (p. 41)
sites.quote: Block 1601 Lots 10, 10.01 & 11: This property on Choctau Trail ... three lots encompass a total area of 7.18 acres in size, yielding a density of 12.2 dwelling units per acre ... 88 of this project's 111 dwellings ... associated with the 3rd Round ... this plan calls for 79 of the 111 affordable units on the Choctau Trail site to be allocated to the 3rd Round. The remaining 32 units (111 units provided less the 79 units that are allocated to the 3rd Round obligation as noted above) are allocated as 4th Round Unmet Need units.
sites.notes: 111 total affordable units (100% affordable project), 7.18 acres, 12.2 du/ac. Site plan approved 9/2021, under construction. 79 units allocated to 3rd Round; 32 units allocated to 4th Round unmet need. Ord. 20-1000 (AH-3).

sites.quote: Overlay Zone: Block 1302 Lots 1.02, 1.03 and 1.04 ... approximately 20 acres ... overlay zone on property along Boroline Road ... retain the underlying Planned Unit Development zoning ... also allow multi-family residential development at thirty units per acre as an overlay zone ... 20% set-aside for affordable housing ... sites.notes: 3rd Round unmet need mechanism. Lot 1.04 (southerly lot) approved with conditions for 275 dwellings, 20% set-aside = 18 family AH units + 15 supportive housing units = 37 AH credits total. Construction not yet commenced. Extends into 4th Round period.
